description: Febres, Jesus and colleagues publish this resource through the native repository. The existing open-source library supplies parametric thermofluid models of district-cooling components for system design. INDIGO reduces these detailed components for model-predictive control and uses simplified forms as planning-tool benchmarks. The related AMBASSADOR publication describes an antecedent thermal-network library, its validation against Apros/IDA-ICE and Simulink reductions; identical code versions are not asserted. Native metadata labels the deposit other-open while the full description explicitly applies Modelica License 2 to the library. The attached licence text was not opened. Zenodo publishes the record with open access and a native licence label of other-open. Source metadata and file descriptors were inspected; no linked files, model archives, code or documentation bodies were opened. Coverage and validation are limited to the stated model, data or application. Publication date does not establish current software maintenance.
